title: Upper Extremity Selective Voluntary Motor Control in Children With Unilateral Cerebral Palsy
brief_summary: The aim of the study was to determine upper extremity selective motor control (SMC) in Children with Unilateral Cerebral Palsy (CP). It was also aimed to determine the relationship between upper extremity SMC and upper extremity functions in unilateral CP.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of unilateral spastic CP,
* age between 5 and 18 years,
* ability to follow simple instructions.

Exclusion Criteria:

* significant ataxia or dystonia
* orthopedic intervention or botulinum toxin injection to the upper extremities in the last 6 months
* orthopedic problems or medical conditions that prevented children from participating in the assessment
